; REQ: LANG-1621 LANG-1622 LANG-1623 LANG-1624
(local greeting "Hello")
(fn greet [name times]
  "Greets name times times."
  (for [i 1 (or times 1)]
    (print (.. greeting ", " name "!\n"))))
(let [config {:name "world" :times 2}]
  (when (and config true)
    (greet config.name config.times)))
(each [k v (pairs {:a 1 :b 2.5})] (print k v))
